Welcome to the official website of the Directorate of Panchayats, Government of Kerala. This department is responsible for coordinating the activities of grama panchayats across the state, including rural development schemes, local self-government administration, and citizen services such as birth and death certificates, property tax records, and welfare pension disbursements.

Notices and circulars are published here regularly. For queries, please use the contact page or visit your nearest panchayat office during working hours.
